title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:44–79 describes nondimensional compressible Navier–Stokes; solver/src/common.h:24–27 and :53–69 define four conserved variables and perfect-gas conversion. Full independent derivation verification is not established.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:34–58 loops unstructured zones and maps boundary edges; :115–121 accepts TRI_3, QUAD_4, BAR_2 section types but rejects CGNS MIXED element sections. global_mesh.cpp:99–190 constructs edge adjacency and polygon geometry; supplied packages exercise the meshes but general multi-zone/mixed layouts were not independently executed.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:781–820 assembles interior numerical and viscous face fluxes; :870–874 adds equal-and-opposite interior contributions to owned cells. Supplied field and residual histories are available, but no independent convergence-order test was run.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp contains HLLC, Roe and Rusanov implementations, selected at :797–799; metadata records HLLC for seven cases and Rusanov for the disclosed M0.15 first-order fallback. A complete independent flux verification was not run.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:823–867 handles farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall fluxes; reported wall-state and surface files provide submitted checks. Independent analytical wall and farfield tests were not repeated.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver/src/solver.cpp:419–478 assembles weighted least-squares gradients and :371–410 reconstructs face states. Report.tex:554–567 discloses production slope factor 0.5 and first-order fallback for M0.15 inviscid, materially limiting accuracy. This is implementation evidence rather than a measured convergence-order claim.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver/src/solver.cpp:508–545 applies neighbor bounds, positivity floor and slope factors. Report.tex:563–567 discloses the first-order M0.15 inviscid fallback and 0.5 production slope elsewhere; no claim of uniform full-order behavior is inferred.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:800–820 assembles Newtonian stress and Fourier heat flux; :586–608 computes full stress-vector wall traction and :1082–1110 directly adds it to viscous forces without tangential projection. Report.tex:166–167,292,312 incorrectly claims tangential-only traction. Surface Cf uses a separate projection. The magnitude of the normal contribution has not been independently quantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:979–1024 implements implicit diagonal and LU-SGS machinery, with production steady point-implicit path described at report.tex:174–184 and transient inner solve. CFL caps differ from supplied high maxima, disclosed in report; independent stability or order tests were not run.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:879–894 forms the BDF2 transient residual; :1359–1418 tests its reduction in the inner loop and shifts physical histories afterward. Submitted Re200 metadata records dt=0.01, t=300, min/max inner 5/300 and all steps meeting target, with force history covering t=0.01–300. BDF2 is used at the first step with identical historical states (:169), an imperfect startup. Unforced result quality is a separate case judgment; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp:296 calls METIS; solver.cpp:231–249 and :329–349 exchange state and gradients with neighbors, :913–915 and :1110 reduce residuals/forces. Submitted np=1/2/4/8 short continuation histories agree within 1e-9 in Cd for a cylinder and a NACA case; report.tex:248–266 documents the shared-restart test and 4-CPU quota. It is not an independent full convergence comparison.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
